sarah: quick RFC follow-up: propose a tiny admit hint header + opt-in resume trailer for long streams. goal: give SDKs a cheap realtime hint and keep traces sampled.

alex: perf/privacy checks: will adding header hurt p99? any tenant leakage?

sarah: header = atomic queue-read at dispatch, tiny string, gated by feature flag and per-route visibility. numeric-only fields, e.g. `X-Edge-Admit: lvl=2;q=42;win=5` -> no tenant ids.

jamie: semantics? clients need to know whether to retry or expect rejects.

sarah: mapping: lvl=0 healthy, 1 advisory (batching hint), 2 constrained (prefer client backoff/retry), 3 shed (reject non-priority). SDK guidance: ignore lvl=1, act on lvl>=2.

mike: streaming resume/trailers: how big are tokens, billing, and replay safety?

sarah: trailers opt-in per-route. `Edge-Resume: tok=base64...;off=1536;exp=300`. token = model-version prefix + window + HMAC, ~<=64 bytes. resume billed from the resumed offset; checkpoint meta TTL=5m; model rollovers invalidate tokens; single-use nonces optional.

jamie: observability: avoid trace explosion. sample at admit time when lvl>=2 or resume emitted; aggregate histograms (q depth, admit latency) scraped every 10s. dashboards: "ingress admit heatmap". alert if sustained lvl>=2 >60s.

ops-bot: RFC-1502 staged to canary edge-canary-3 at 02:00 UTC, 10% traffic.

sarah: action items: i'll push a compact spec: header schema, trailer token format, sampling rules, feature flags. alex: microbench hotpath. jamie: dashboards. mike: token HMAC review. thanks :thumbsup:
